methodology.commission: $0.50 per side per micro ($1.00 round turn)
methodology.fill: completed signal bar; next-minute open; one adverse tick entry and exit; stop-first ambiguity; gap-worse stop; every open position marked at the adverse one-minute extreme; floor touch fails
methodology.primary_windows: non-overlapping 45-session blocks beginning at the first test session
methodology.rolling_starts: diagnostic only; never used as the headline probability
methodology.selection_warning: The strategy and account-size choice predate this corrected replay, but the test era has already been inspected; this is confirmatory, not pristine OOS.
methodology.uncertainty: Exact binomial interval on disjoint blocks plus 20-session circular block resampling; neither repairs proxy-data model risk.

monte_carlo.method: 20-session circular block resampling with minute-marked shared-account replay
monte_carlo.warning: Resampling quantifies historical path variation; it cannot repair proxy-data or model error.

risk_controls.basis: counts across non-overlapping 45-session primary test paths

selected.event_filter: Not applied historically: no point-in-time high-impact calendar archive is available.
limitations: Dukascopy CFD/index proxy bars, not CME futures bid/ask or queue data.

strategy_rules.entry: Marketable entry at the 09:45 one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: At 09:44 NY, the first 15-minute close must move at least 25% of the prior RTH range from today's open and close in the outer 20% of today's opening range in that direction.
strategy_rules.target: 2.0R; stop-first on an ambiguous one-minute bar.

strategy_rules.entry: Marketable entry at the 09:45 one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: At 09:44 NY, the overnight gap must be at least 10% of the prior RTH range, the first 15 minutes must move against the gap, and the close must be in the outer 20% of the opening range toward the fill.
strategy_rules.stop: One tick beyond the first 15-minute range extreme.
strategy_rules.target: 1.5R; stop-first on an ambiguous one-minute bar.

strategy_rules.entry: Next one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: On a completed clock-aligned 15-minute bar, close crosses beyond today's open ±25% of the prior RTH range.
strategy_rules.stop: One tick beyond the signal 15-minute bar extreme.
strategy_rules.target: 2.0R; at most the first valid signal of the session.

verdict.reason: The replay is now conservative about account-rule breaches, but the source and sample cannot validate a real Lucid pass edge.

validation_gates.detail: Every open position is marked each source minute; an equity touch of the prior-EOD floor is a breach.
Primary probabilities use disjoint 45-session blocks; overlapping starts are diagnostic only.
Dukascopy index/CFD proxy OHLC is not CME MES/MNQ bid/ask, trades, contract rolls, or queue data.
The 2024+ period and nearby parameter variants were already inspected before this rebuild.
Commission is sourced, but historical spread and slippage are modeled rather than observed fills.
No point-in-time economic-calendar archive is applied to historical signals.
Only 14 non-overlapping blocks are available; the exact pass interval is 17.7%–71.1%, wider than the 20-point decision-precision limit.
